hooks.name: Docs Maintenance Reminder
hooks.description: Reminds the agent, at the start of every session, to keep BhavishAI's living documentation in lockstep with code changes per docs/DOCS_MAINTENANCE.md.

action.prompt:
LIVING DOCUMENTATION CONTRACT (BhavishAI): This project keeps docs in lockstep with code. For every change/iteration you make, before opening a PR you MUST also update the matching documentation in the SAME PR:
1) docs/agent-activity-log.md — add a new top entry (Asked → Interpreted → Did → Files affected → Impact → Branch/PR).
2) commands/ — correct the relevant reference file if you added/removed/changed any API route (api-routes.md), lib module (lib-modules.md), page/component (pages.md), command/script/migration (cli-commands.md), or cron/ops endpoint (cron-and-ops.md).
3) docs/*.md and PROJECT.md — update architecture, prd, requirements, bugs, implementation_plan, testing, or audit whenever the change affects them, and bump the "Last updated" date on every doc you touch.
Code is the source of truth: verify claims against the actual source, and separate resolved issues from genuinely open ones. See docs/DOCS_MAINTENANCE.md for the full checklist. Treat this as a standing instruction for the whole session.
